verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents a broad RESTful API and PowerShell module. Per its docs, these cover core directory services, cross-OS device management, onboarding/offboarding workflows, bulk operations across users, devices and groups, and event export. A published API 2.0 spec exposes graph-traversal endpoints, and a GitHub support repo supplies API examples. However, nothing claims or demonstrates full UI-to-API parity, and the spec was not found at the standard OpenAPI paths probed (the index.yaml spec does exist). Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement or coverage matrix, evidence that newer areas (password vault, conditional access, SSO/MFA configuration, RADIUS) are API-manageable, and independent hands-on confirmation of API completeness.
